questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C). See the explanation of above question. 122 Gopal Krishna Gokhale founded Servants of India Society in the year (a) 1907 (b) 1906 (c) 1904 (d) 1905 (e) Question not attempted Raj. P.C.S. (Pre) 2023 Ans. (d) The 'Servants of Indian Society' was founded by Gopal Krishna Gokhale at Fergusson hill on June 12, 1905, in the Pune district of Maharashtra. Gokhale founded the society along with three of his friends – Natesh Appaji Dravid, Gopal Krishna Deodhar and Anant Vinayak Patwardhan, all of whom become lifelong members of the society. The society focused on nation-building activities such as education, social welfare, upliftment of the downtrodden and betterment of the underprivileged section of society. 123. Who was the founder of Bahujan Samaj? (a) Sri Narayan Guru (b) Mukund Rao Patil (c) Dr. B.R. Ambedkar (d) B.R. Shinde U.P. Lower Sub. (Spl) (Pre) 2010 Ans. (b) Mukund Rao Patil and Shankar Rao Jadhav founded Bahujan Samaj to oppose the exploitation of the lower castes by upper castes including Brahmins, money-lenders, and landlords. It also opposed the Indian National Congress Party. Later, it became the supporter of the British Government. 124. Who demanded the right to enter temples that caused a terrible riot in Tirunevali in 1899? (a) Okalinga (b) Nadars (c) Mahar (d) Pali 40th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 1995 Ans. (b) Nadars demanded the right to enter temples in 1899 which caused a terrible riot in Tirunelveli district Tamil Nadu. 125. Who said that “If God were to tolerate untouchability, I would not recognize him as God at all.” (a) B.R. Ambedkar (b) Bal Gangadhar Tilak (c) Lala Lajpat Rai (d) Mahatma Gandhi U.P.P.C.S. (Spl) (Mains) 2004 Ans. (b) Tilak said that all Indians are children of the same motherland. There could be no spiritual and moral defence of untouchability. He said in thundering words: “If God were to tolerate untouchability, I would not recognize him as God at all.” 126. Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the codes given below- A. Raja Ram Mohan Roy 1. Said that Brahmovad should be made the religion of the world. B. Keshav Chandra Sen 2. Identiﬁ ed Hinduism with religion instituted in Vedas. C Dayanand Saraswati 3. Emphasized that there are several ways to reach God. D. Ramakrishna 4. Purest form of Hinduism Paramhansa is contained in Upanishads Code : A B C D (a) 1 4 2 3 (b) 1 4 3 2 (c) 4 1 3 2 (d) 4 1 2 3 U.P. Lower Sub. (Pre) 1998 Ans. (d) The correct match is- Raja Ram Mohan Roy - Purest form of Hinduism is con- tained in Upanishads. Keshav Chandra Sen - That Brahmovad should be made the religion of the world. Dayanand Saraswati - Identiﬁ ed Hinduism with religion instituted in Vedas. Ramakrishna Paramhansa- Emphasized that there are several ways to reach God. 127. Which one of the following is not correctly matched: (a) A.Pandurang – Prarthana Samaj (b) Dayanand Saraswati – Arya Samaj (c) Raja Ram Mohan Roy – Adi Brahma Samaj (d) Vivekanand – Ram Krishna Mission U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 1997 Ans. (c) Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded Brahmo Samaj on August 20, 1828, at Calcutta. Later, under Devendra Nath Tagore it was called ‘Adi Brahmo Samaj.’ In 1866, Brahmo Samaj was divided into two parts, ‘Adi Brahmo Samaj’ under Devendra Nath Tagore and ‘Bhartiya Brahmo Samaj’ under Keshav Chandra Sen. 128. Which of the following is NOT correctly matched? Organisation Person (a) Young Bengal Movement - Henry Vivian Derozeo (b) Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha - Jyotiba Phuble (c) Theosophical Society - Colonel Olcott (d) United Indian Patriotic Association - Syed Ahmad Khan U.P.R.O./A.R.O. (Pre) (Re-Exam) 2016 Ans (b) Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha was formed by Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar. Rest of the options are correctly matched. 129. Match List – I with List – II and select the correct answer from the code given below the lists. List -I List-II (Persons) (Associated works/ Posts) A. D. K. Karve 1. Establishment of Girls School in Calcutta B. J. E. D. Bethune 2. Secretary, Widow Re- marriage Association C. Ishwar Chandra 3. Starting a crusade Vidyasagar against child marriage D. B. M. Malabari 4. Principal of Sanskrit College in Calcutta Code : A B C D (a) 2 1 4 3 (b) 1 2 3 4 (c) 1 2 4 3 (d) 2 1 3 4 U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2022 Ans. (a) Correctly matched list is as follows— List -I List-II (Persons) (Associated works/ Posts) D. K. Karve - Secretary, Widow Re- marriage Association J. E. D. Bethune - Establishment of Girls School in Calcutta Ishwar Chandra - Principal of Sanskrit Vidyasagar College in Calcutta B. M. Malabari - Starting a crusade against child marriage 130. Indentify the correct combination from the options given below for Prarthana Samaj, Young India, Lokahitavadi, Satyashodhak Samaj, Rehnumai Mazdayasan Sabha: (a) Gopal Hari Deshmukh, Atmaram Pandurang, Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, Jyotiba Phule, Naoroji Furdonji. (b) Atmaram Pandurang, Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, Gopal Hari Deshmukh, Jyotiba Phule, Naoroji Furdonji (c) Atmaram Pandurang, Jyotiba Phule, Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, Gopal Hari Deshmukh, Naoroji Furdonji. (d) Naoroji Furdonji, Atmaram Pandurang, Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, Gopal Hari Deshmukh, Jyotiba Phule. (e) None of the above/More than one of the above B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2018 Ans. (b) Prarthana Samaj was a movement for religions and social reforms in Bombay based on earlier reforms movements. It was founded by Atmaram Pandurang in 1867. Young India was published by Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi. Gopal Hari Deshmukh was an Indian activist, thinker, social reformer and writer from Maharashtra. He was popularly known as Lokahitvadi. Satya Shodhak Samaj was founded by Jyotiba Phule in Pune in 1873. Rehnumai Mazdayasan Sabha started in 1851 by Naoroji Furdonji and others was a Parsi religious Reform Association. 131. Which one of the following is correctly matched? (a) Bharat Dharma Mahamandal – Delhi (b) Deva Samaj – Banaras (c) Radhaswami Satsang – Lahore (d) Sanatan Dharma Rakshini Sabha – Calcutta U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2022 Ans. (d) Correct match is as Follows — Bharat Dharma Mahamandal – Haridwar Deva Samaj – Lahore Radhaswami Satsang – Agra Sanatan Dharma Rakshini Sabha – Calcutta 132. Who among the following social reformers was known for proﬁ ciency in the Sanskrit language? (a) Dayanand Saraswati (b) Iswar Chandra Vidyasagar (c) Raja Rammohan Roy (d) All the above U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2013 Ans. (d) Dayanand Saraswati, Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar and Raja Ram Mohan Roy made tireless eﬀ orts for socio-religious reforms in India during British rule. All of them were proﬁ cient in Sanskrit language and denied the evils of Hindu religion and society. 133. Read the following statements carefully– 1. Brahmo Samaj supported monotheism. 2. Arya Samaj contributed to the development of education. 3. Swami Vivekanand founded Ramakrishna Mission. Answer on the basis of the following code : (a) 1, 2 and 3 are true (b) 1 and 2 and true (c) 1 and 3 are true (d) 2 and 3 are true Chhattisgarh P.C.S. (Pre) 2008 Ans. (a) Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded Brahmo Samaj on August 20, 1828, at Calcutta. This society denied idolatry, anthropomorp- hism, sacerdotalism and preached the universal worship of God. Arya Samaj was founded by Swami Dayanand Saraswati in 1875. The followers of this society had played an important role in the development of knowledge and education. Ramakrishna Mission was founded by Swami Vivekananda in 1897. 134. The women’s movement in India started largely under the inspiration of : (a) Padmabai Ranaday (b) Annie Besant (c) Sarojini Naidu (d) Jyotiba Phule 48th to 52nd B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2008 Ans. (d) The women’s movement in India started largely under inspirations of Jyotiba Phule. He used to believe that social evils could be eliminated only after uplifting the women and Dalits. He opened the ﬁ rst school for girls in India in 1848. Ramabai Ranade was the inspiration of the women’s movement in Modern India. She was the wife of Mahadev Govind Ranade. She founded an organization ‘Seva Sadan’. If Ramabai is mentioned in the given options, then it will be the correct answer. This was the reason that the Bihar Public Service Commission did not consider any option as correct and starred the question. 135.What was common among Brahma Samaj, Ram Krishna Mission, and Arya Samaj? (a) None of these three had a political mission but they helped to develop a spirit of patriotism (b) All the three originated from Bengal (c) Founder of all the three was educated in England (d) Founder of all the three took active part in politics R.A.S./R.T.S.(Pre) 2008 Ans. (a) Brahmo Samaj, Ramakrishna Mission and Arya Samaj, all of them, helped in social reforms, development of education and development of patriotism. None of these had a political mission but they helped to develop the spirit of patriotism. 136. Which of the following statement is not correct? (a) Dr. Annie Besant was a Theosophist. (b) The International headquarter of Theosophical society is in Madras. (c) Swami Dayanand founded Arya Samaj. (d) Mahatma Gandhi was born in Gandhinagar. M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 1995 Ans. (d) Mahatma Gandhi was born on October 2, 1869, at Porbandar. Hence option (d) is incorrect. Annie Besant became the chairman of the Theosophical Society after the death of Colonel Alcott in 1907. She came in the contact of this society in 1882 and became the oﬃ cial member in 1889. In 1879, the principal founders, Madam H.P. Blavatsky and Col. Alcott moved to India, where the Society spread rapidly. In 1882, they established the Society’s International Headquarters in Adyar, a suburb of Madras (currently Chennai). Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded Arya Samaj in 1875 in Bombay. 137. Consider the following pairs : Movement/Organisation Leader 1. All India Anti-Untouchability : Mahatma Gandhi League 2. All India Kisan Sabha : Swami Sahaj- anand Saraswati 3. Self-Respect Movement : E.V. Ramaswami Naicker Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched? (a) 1 only (b) 1 and 2 only (c) 2 and 3 only (d) 1, 2 and 3 I.A.S. (Pre) 2019 Ans. (d) All India Anti-Untouchability league which was later renamed as Harijan Sevak Sangh was founded by Mahatma Gandhi in 1932. All India Kisan Sabha was established by Swami Sahajanand Saraswati in 1936 at Lucknow with Sahajanand as its President and N.G. Ranga as General Secretary. Self- Respect movement was started by E.V. Ramaswami Naicker (famous as Periyar) for providing equal rights to so called lower caste people in Tamil Nadu. 138. Who advocated 'Neo-Buddhism'? (a) Radhakrishnan (b) Tagore (c) Ambedkar (d) Vivekananda Chhattisgarh P.S.C. (Pre) 2018 Ans. (c) Neo-Buddhism was name given to Dalit Bauddha Movement started by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. Under this, Buddhism was redeﬁ ned and new Buddhist sect 'Navayan' was founded. 139. ‘Dar-ul-Ulum was established by – (a) Maulana Shibli Numani (b) Maulavi Hussain Ahmad (c) Maulavi Abdullah Chakralavi (d) Maulana Ahmad Riza Khan U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2014 Ans. (a) ‘Dar-ul’Ulum’ Nadwatul Ulma in General known as Dar- Ul-Uloom was established at Lucknow in 1898. It was established by Nadwatul Ulma. Nadwatul Uloom was established by Maulana Luftullah and Maulana Shibli Numani at Kanpur in 1893. Shibli Numani was a teacher at Dar-ul-Uloom or Ulum. 140. Paramahansa Mandali was established in which State? (a) Orissa (b) Bengal (c) Maharashtra (d) Bihar M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2022 Ans. (c) The Paramahansa Mandali was indeed a secret socio-religious group founded in Bombay, Maharashtra. It was established by Dadoba Pandurang Tarkhadkar, who aimed to promote a form of monotheism and reform within the Hindu society. 141. The Deoband Movement in U.P. (United Province) started in the year (a) 1900 A.D. (b) 1888 A.D. (c) 1885 A.D. (d) 1866 A.D. U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2016 Ans. (d) Deoband Movement was started in 1866 A.D. at Deoband in Sahranpur district of U.P. (United Province) with an avowed objective to overthrow the British rule in Indian sub-continent and restore Islamic rule. It was founded by Hazrat Maulana Muhammed Qasim Nanotavi, Rashid Ahmed Gangohi, Saiyad Ahmed Abid, Zulﬁ qar Ali etc. 142. Who began the Faraizi Movement? (a) Haji Shariatullah (b) Syed Ahmed (c) Salimullah (d) M.A. Jinnah (e) None of the above/More than one of the above B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2018 Ans. (a) Faraizi movement was started by Haji Shariatullah. It was a movement against the British rule because they didn’t allow Muslims to practise their religion with freedom and their rights were conﬁ scated. 143. The Tarkeshwar Movement of 1924 in Bengal was against: (a) Corruption in temples (b) Violence (c) Arrest of political leaders (d) Communalism U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) (Re. Exam) 2015 Ans. (a) The Tarkeswar Movement of 1924 in Calcutta (Bengal) was against the corrupt priest (Mahant) of Tarkeswar Shiva temple. The Priest here were accused of misbehaviour, harassment and unjust ﬁ nancial demands against the pilgrims. 144. ‘Hali System’ concerned : (a) Bonded labour (b) Exploitation of peasants (c) Untouchability (d) Illiteracy U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2015 Ans. (a) Hali System was concerned with bonded labour. 145. Who among the following leaders founded the revolutionary organization – 'Abhinav Bharat Society'? (a) Bhagat Singh (b) Vinayak Damodar Savarkar (c) Barindra Kumar Ghosh (d) Pulin Bihari U.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2018 Ans. (b) Vinayak Damodar Savarkar along with his brother Ganesh Damodar Savarkar started an organisation 'Mitra Mela'. It was renamed by V.D. Savarkar as 'Abhinav Bharat Society' at Nashik in 1904 Political Organisations Established Before Congress *Raja Ram Mohan Roy was the guide of social reforms and political movements in Modern India. His associates in 1836 for the ﬁ rst time started an association called Bangbhasa Prakashika Sabha. Raja Ram Mohan Roy was the earliest individual to struggle for political reforms in India. *Zamindari Association or Landholders society was established at Calcutta in 1838. This society marked the beginning of an organized political activity and use of methods of constitutional agitation for the redressal of grievances. The aim of the Society was to safeguard the rights of Zamindars. This Society was founded by Dwarkanath Tagore and his fellow Zamindars. * The Poona Sarvajanik sabha was one of the strongest political organiation of 19th century India. It was launched on 2 April 1870 in the Pune district of Maharashtra. It was the result of the labour of many great men like G.V. Joshi, S.H. Sathe and S.H. Chiplonkar. Fresh vigour and energy were infused into the sabha in November 1871 with the entry of M.G. Ranade. M.G. Ranade provided fantastic leadership to this Sabha. In 1875 this Sabha presented a petition in British House of Commons. The petition consisted of the demands of representatives of India. *Indian Association was founded on 26 th July, 1876 by Surendranath Banerjee with the help of Anand Mohan Bose in Calcutta. This was the most important political association before Congress with the tag of an All India Nationalist Organisation. Surendranath Banerjee passed the Civil Services exam in 1869, but as there was some trouble over his exact age he was declared disqualiﬁ ed. He published 'The Bengalee' newspaper for the promotion of mass consciousness. He was Congress President twice. *British Indian Association was started on October, 1851 in Calcutta whose founders were Rajendra Lal Mitra, Radhakant Dev (President) and Devendra Nath Tagore (General Secretary) etc. *Sayed Amir Ali in 1877 founded Central National Mohammadian Association at Calcutta. *Getting inspired from Raj Narayan Bose, Nabagopal Mitra in 1867 founded a Society named ‘Hindu Mela’. The main aim of this society was to promote the feeling of autonomy and use of indigenous goods amongst the masses.* In 1843, George Thompson founded Bengal British India Society.* Bombay Presidency Association was founded in 1885 by Firozshah Mehta, K.T. Telang and Badruddin Tyabjee. These three are known as Trimurti of Bombay. 1. The ﬁ rst Political Organization established in India in 1838 was known as (a) British India Society (b) Bengal British India Society (c) Settlers Association (d) Zamindari Association Uttarakhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2010 I.A.S. (Pre) 1993 Ans. (d) The ﬁ rst political organization established in India was known as the Zamindari Association or Landholders Society (1838) in Calcutta. It was the ﬁ rst political organisation which introduced organized eﬀ orts and constitutional remedies for complaints. Its main purpose was to secure the interests of landlords. The founder members were Dwaraka Nath Tagore and his associate landlords. 2. Given below are two statements, in which one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R): Assertion (A): The Bengal British Indian Society was founded in 1843 as a result of George Thompson's eﬀ orts. Reason (R): George Thompson was brought out from England by Dwarkanath Tagore to organise the political movement.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (C) उपरोक्त प्रश्न का स्पष्टीकरण देखें. 122 गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले ने सर्वेंट्स ऑफ इंडिया सोसाइटी की स्थापना वर्ष में की थी (ए) 1907 (बी) 1906 (सी) 1904 (डी) 1905 (ई) प्रश्न का प्रयास नहीं किया गया राज। पी.सी.एस. (पूर्व) 2023 उत्तर. (डी) 'सर्वेंट्स ऑफ इंडियन सोसाइटी' की स्थापना 12 जून, 1905 को महाराष्ट्र के पुणे जिले में फर्ग्यूसन पहाड़ी पर गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले द्वारा की गई थी। गोखले ने अपने तीन दोस्तों - नतेश अप्पाजी द्रविड़, गोपाल कृष्ण देवधर और अनंत विनायक पटवर्धन के साथ सोसायटी की स्थापना की, ये सभी सोसायटी के आजीवन सदस्य बने। समाज ने शिक्षा, सामाजिक कल्याण, वंचितों के उत्थान और समाज के वंचित वर्ग की बेहतरी जैसी राष्ट्र-निर्माण गतिविधियों पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया। 123.बहुजन समाज के संस्थापक कौन थे? सोसायटी का मुख्य उद्देश्य जनता के बीच स्वायत्तता की भावना और स्वदेशी वस्तुओं के उपयोग को बढ़ावा देना था। * 1843 में, जॉर्ज थॉम्पसन ने बंगाल ब्रिटिश इंडिया सोसाइटी की स्थापना की। * बॉम्बे प्रेसीडेंसी एसोसिएशन की स्थापना 1885 में फिरोजशाह मेहता, के.टी. द्वारा की गई थी। तेलंग और बदरुद्दीन तैयबजी। इन तीनों को बॉम्बे की त्रिमूर्ति के नाम से जाना जाता है। 1. 1838 में भारत में स्थापित पहला राजनीतिक संगठन इस नाम से जाना जाता था (ए) ब्रिटिश इंडिया सोसाइटी (बी) बंगाल ब्रिटिश इंडिया सोसाइटी (सी) सेटलर्स एसोसिएशन (डी) जमींदारी एसोसिएशन उत्तराखंड पी.सी.एस. (पूर्व) 2010 आई.ए.एस. (पूर्व) 1993 उत्तर. (डी) भारत में स्थापित पहला राजनीतिक संगठन कलकत्ता में जमींदारी एसोसिएशन या लैंडहोल्डर्स सोसाइटी (1838) के नाम से जाना जाता था। यह पहला राजनीतिक संगठन था जिसने शिकायतों के लिए संगठित प्रयास और संवैधानिक उपचार पेश किए। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य जमींदारों के हितों को सुरक्षित करना था। संस्थापक सदस्य द्वारका नाथ टैगोर और उनके सहयोगी जमींदार थे। 2. नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं, जिनमें से एक को दावा (ए) और दूसरे को कारण (आर) के रूप में लेबल किया गया है: दावा (ए): जॉर्ज थॉम्पसन के प्रयासों के परिणामस्वरूप 1843 में बंगाल ब्रिटिश इंडियन सोसाइटी की स्थापना की गई थी। कारण (आर): जॉर्ज थॉम्पसन को राजनीतिक आंदोलन को संगठित करने के लिए द्वारकानाथ टैगोर द्वारा इंग्लैंड से बाहर लाया गया था।

questions.question_en: Who established the 'Servants of India Society'?

options_en: Bhagat Singh (e) None of the above/More than one of the above
options_hi: भगत सिंह (ई) उपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं/उपरोक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_en: Correct Answer: (C). See the explanation of above question. 122 Gopal Krishna Gokhale founded Servants of India Society in the year (a) 1907 (b) 1906 (c) 1904 (d) 1905 (e) Question not attempted Raj. P.C.S. (Pre) 2023 Ans. (d) The 'Servants of Indian Society' was founded by Gopal Krishna Gokhale at Fergusson hill on June 12, 1905, in the Pune district of Maharashtra. Gokhale founded the society along with three of his friends – Natesh Appaji Dravid, Gopal Krishna Deodhar and Anant Vinayak Patwardhan, all of whom become lifelong members of the society. The society focused on nation-building activities such as education, social welfare, upliftment of the downtrodden and betterment of the underprivileged section of society. 123. Who was the founder of Bahujan Samaj? (a) Sri Narayan Guru (b) Mukund Rao Patil (c) Dr. B.R. Ambedkar (d) B.R. Shinde U.P. Lower Sub. (Spl) (Pre) 2010 Ans. (b) Mukund Rao Patil and Shankar Rao Jadhav founded Bahujan Samaj to oppose the exploitation of the lower castes by upper castes including Brahmins, money-lenders, and landlords. It also opposed the Indian National Congress Party. Later, it became the supporter of the British Government. 124. Who demanded the right to enter temples that caused a terrible riot in Tirunevali in 1899? (a) Okalinga (b) Nadars (c) Mahar (d) Pali 40th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 1995 Ans. (b) Nadars demanded the right to enter temples in 1899 which caused a terrible riot in Tirunelveli district Tamil Nadu. 125. Who said that “If God were to tolerate untouchability, I would not recognize him as God at all.” (a) B.R. Ambedkar (b) Bal Gangadhar Tilak (c) Lala Lajpat Rai (d) Mahatma Gandhi U.P.P.C.S. (Spl) (Mains) 2004 Ans. (b) Tilak said that all Indians are children of the same motherland. There could be no spiritual and moral defence of untouchability. He said in thundering words: “If God were to tolerate untouchability, I would not recognize him as God at all.” 126. Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the codes given below- A. Raja Ram Mohan Roy 1. Said that Brahmovad should be made the religion of the world. B. Keshav Chandra Sen 2. Identiﬁ ed Hinduism with religion instituted in Vedas. C Dayanand Saraswati 3. Emphasized that there are several ways to reach God. D. Ramakrishna 4. Purest form of Hinduism Paramhansa is contained in Upanishads Code : A B C D (a) 1 4 2 3 (b) 1 4 3 2 (c) 4 1 3 2 (d) 4 1 2 3 U.P. Lower Sub. (Pre) 1998 Ans. (d) The correct match is- Raja Ram Mohan Roy - Purest form of Hinduism is con- tained in Upanishads. Keshav Chandra Sen - That Brahmovad should be made the religion of the world. Dayanand Saraswati - Identiﬁ ed Hinduism with religion instituted in Vedas. Ramakrishna Paramhansa- Emphasized that there are several ways to reach God. 127. Which one of the following is not correctly matched: (a) A.Pandurang – Prarthana Samaj (b) Dayanand Saraswati – Arya Samaj (c) Raja Ram Mohan Roy – Adi Brahma Samaj (d) Vivekanand – Ram Krishna Mission U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 1997 Ans. (c) Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded Brahmo Samaj on August 20, 1828, at Calcutta. Later, under Devendra Nath Tagore it was called ‘Adi Brahmo Samaj.’ In 1866, Brahmo Samaj was divided into two parts, ‘Adi Brahmo Samaj’ under Devendra Nath Tagore and ‘Bhartiya Brahmo Samaj’ under Keshav Chandra Sen. 128. Which of the following is NOT correctly matched? Organisation Person (a) Young Bengal Movement - Henry Vivian Derozeo (b) Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha - Jyotiba Phuble (c) Theosophical Society - Colonel Olcott (d) United Indian Patriotic Association - Syed Ahmad Khan U.P.R.O./A.R.O. (Pre) (Re-Exam) 2016 Ans (b) Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha was formed by Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar. Rest of the options are correctly matched. 129. Match List – I with List – II and select the correct answer from the code given below the lists. List -I List-II (Persons) (Associated works/ Posts) A. D. K. Karve 1. Establishment of Girls School in Calcutta B. J. E. D. Bethune 2. Secretary, Widow Re- marriage Association C. Ishwar Chandra 3. Starting a crusade Vidyasagar against child marriage D. B. M. Malabari 4. Principal of Sanskrit College in Calcutta Code : A B C D (a) 2 1 4 3 (b) 1 2 3 4 (c) 1 2 4 3 (d) 2 1 3 4 U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2022 Ans. (a) Correctly matched list is as follows— List -I List-II (Persons) (Associated works/ Posts) D. K. Karve - Secretary, Widow Re- marriage Association J. E. D. Bethune - Establishment of Girls School in Calcutta Ishwar Chandra - Principal of Sanskrit Vidyasagar College in Calcutta B. M. Malabari - Starting a crusade against child marriage 130. Indentify the correct combination from the options given below for Prarthana Samaj, Young India, Lokahitavadi, Satyashodhak Samaj, Rehnumai Mazdayasan Sabha: (a) Gopal Hari Deshmukh, Atmaram Pandurang, Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, Jyotiba Phule, Naoroji Furdonji. (b) Atmaram Pandurang, Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, Gopal Hari Deshmukh, Jyotiba Phule, Naoroji Furdonji (c) Atmaram Pandurang, Jyotiba Phule, Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, Gopal Hari Deshmukh, Naoroji Furdonji. (d) Naoroji Furdonji, Atmaram Pandurang, Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, Gopal Hari Deshmukh, Jyotiba Phule. (e) None of the above/More than one of the above B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2018 Ans. (b) Prarthana Samaj was a movement for religions and social reforms in Bombay based on earlier reforms movements. It was founded by Atmaram Pandurang in 1867. Young India was published by Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi. Gopal Hari Deshmukh was an Indian activist, thinker, social reformer and writer from Maharashtra. He was popularly known as Lokahitvadi. Satya Shodhak Samaj was founded by Jyotiba Phule in Pune in 1873. Rehnumai Mazdayasan Sabha started in 1851 by Naoroji Furdonji and others was a Parsi religious Reform Association. 131. Which one of the following is correctly matched? (a) Bharat Dharma Mahamandal – Delhi (b) Deva Samaj – Banaras (c) Radhaswami Satsang – Lahore (d) Sanatan Dharma Rakshini Sabha – Calcutta U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2022 Ans. (d) Correct match is as Follows — Bharat Dharma Mahamandal – Haridwar Deva Samaj – Lahore Radhaswami Satsang – Agra Sanatan Dharma Rakshini Sabha – Calcutta 132. Who among the following social reformers was known for proﬁ ciency in the Sanskrit language? (a) Dayanand Saraswati (b) Iswar Chandra Vidyasagar (c) Raja Rammohan Roy (d) All the above U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2013 Ans. (d) Dayanand Saraswati, Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar and Raja Ram Mohan Roy made tireless eﬀ orts for socio-religious reforms in India during British rule. All of them were proﬁ cient in Sanskrit language and denied the evils of Hindu religion and society. 133. Read the following statements carefully– 1. Brahmo Samaj supported monotheism. 2. Arya Samaj contributed to the development of education. 3. Swami Vivekanand founded Ramakrishna Mission. Answer on the basis of the following code : (a) 1, 2 and 3 are true (b) 1 and 2 and true (c) 1 and 3 are true (d) 2 and 3 are true Chhattisgarh P.C.S. (Pre) 2008 Ans. (a) Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded Brahmo Samaj on August 20, 1828, at Calcutta. This society denied idolatry, anthropomorp- hism, sacerdotalism and preached the universal worship of God. Arya Samaj was founded by Swami Dayanand Saraswati in 1875. The followers of this society had played an important role in the development of knowledge and education. Ramakrishna Mission was founded by Swami Vivekananda in 1897. 134. The women’s movement in India started largely under the inspiration of : (a) Padmabai Ranaday (b) Annie Besant (c) Sarojini Naidu (d) Jyotiba Phule 48th to 52nd B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2008 Ans. (d) The women’s movement in India started largely under inspirations of Jyotiba Phule. He used to believe that social evils could be eliminated only after uplifting the women and Dalits. He opened the ﬁ rst school for girls in India in 1848. Ramabai Ranade was the inspiration of the women’s movement in Modern India. She was the wife of Mahadev Govind Ranade. She founded an organization ‘Seva Sadan’. If Ramabai is mentioned in the given options, then it will be the correct answer. This was the reason that the Bihar Public Service Commission did not consider any option as correct and starred the question. 135.What was common among Brahma Samaj, Ram Krishna Mission, and Arya Samaj? (a) None of these three had a political mission but they helped to develop a spirit of patriotism (b) All the three originated from Bengal (c) Founder of all the three was educated in England (d) Founder of all the three took active part in politics R.A.S./R.T.S.(Pre) 2008 Ans. (a) Brahmo Samaj, Ramakrishna Mission and Arya Samaj, all of them, helped in social reforms, development of education and development of patriotism. None of these had a political mission but they helped to develop the spirit of patriotism. 136. Which of the following statement is not correct? (a) Dr. Annie Besant was a Theosophist. (b) The International headquarter of Theosophical society is in Madras. (c) Swami Dayanand founded Arya Samaj. (d) Mahatma Gandhi was born in Gandhinagar. M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 1995 Ans. (d) Mahatma Gandhi was born on October 2, 1869, at Porbandar. Hence option (d) is incorrect. Annie Besant became the chairman of the Theosophical Society after the death of Colonel Alcott in 1907. She came in the contact of this society in 1882 and became the oﬃ cial member in 1889. In 1879, the principal founders, Madam H.P. Blavatsky and Col. Alcott moved to India, where the Society spread rapidly. In 1882, they established the Society’s International Headquarters in Adyar, a suburb of Madras (currently Chennai). Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded Arya Samaj in 1875 in Bombay. 137. Consider the following pairs : Movement/Organisation Leader 1. All India Anti-Untouchability : Mahatma Gandhi League 2. All India Kisan Sabha : Swami Sahaj- anand Saraswati 3. Self-Respect Movement : E.V. Ramaswami Naicker Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched? (a) 1 only (b) 1 and 2 only (c) 2 and 3 only (d) 1, 2 and 3 I.A.S. (Pre) 2019 Ans. (d) All India Anti-Untouchability league which was later renamed as Harijan Sevak Sangh was founded by Mahatma Gandhi in 1932. All India Kisan Sabha was established by Swami Sahajanand Saraswati in 1936 at Lucknow with Sahajanand as its President and N.G. Ranga as General Secretary. Self- Respect movement was started by E.V. Ramaswami Naicker (famous as Periyar) for providing equal rights to so called lower caste people in Tamil Nadu. 138. Who advocated 'Neo-Buddhism'? (a) Radhakrishnan (b) Tagore (c) Ambedkar (d) Vivekananda Chhattisgarh P.S.C. (Pre) 2018 Ans. (c) Neo-Buddhism was name given to Dalit Bauddha Movement started by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. Under this, Buddhism was redeﬁ ned and new Buddhist sect 'Navayan' was founded. 139. ‘Dar-ul-Ulum was established by – (a) Maulana Shibli Numani (b) Maulavi Hussain Ahmad (c) Maulavi Abdullah Chakralavi (d) Maulana Ahmad Riza Khan U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2014 Ans. (a) ‘Dar-ul’Ulum’ Nadwatul Ulma in General known as Dar- Ul-Uloom was established at Lucknow in 1898. It was established by Nadwatul Ulma. Nadwatul Uloom was established by Maulana Luftullah and Maulana Shibli Numani at Kanpur in 1893. Shibli Numani was a teacher at Dar-ul-Uloom or Ulum. 140. Paramahansa Mandali was established in which State? (a) Orissa (b) Bengal (c) Maharashtra (d) Bihar M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2022 Ans. (c) The Paramahansa Mandali was indeed a secret socio-religious group founded in Bombay, Maharashtra. It was established by Dadoba Pandurang Tarkhadkar, who aimed to promote a form of monotheism and reform within the Hindu society. 141. The Deoband Movement in U.P. (United Province) started in the year (a) 1900 A.D. (b) 1888 A.D. (c) 1885 A.D. (d) 1866 A.D. U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2016 Ans. (d) Deoband Movement was started in 1866 A.D. at Deoband in Sahranpur district of U.P. (United Province) with an avowed objective to overthrow the British rule in Indian sub-continent and restore Islamic rule. It was founded by Hazrat Maulana Muhammed Qasim Nanotavi, Rashid Ahmed Gangohi, Saiyad Ahmed Abid, Zulﬁ qar Ali etc. 142. Who began the Faraizi Movement? (a) Haji Shariatullah (b) Syed Ahmed (c) Salimullah (d) M.A. Jinnah (e) None of the above/More than one of the above B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2018 Ans. (a) Faraizi movement was started by Haji Shariatullah. It was a movement against the British rule because they didn’t allow Muslims to practise their religion with freedom and their rights were conﬁ scated. 143. The Tarkeshwar Movement of 1924 in Bengal was against: (a) Corruption in temples (b) Violence (c) Arrest of political leaders (d) Communalism U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) (Re. Exam) 2015 Ans. (a) The Tarkeswar Movement of 1924 in Calcutta (Bengal) was against the corrupt priest (Mahant) of Tarkeswar Shiva temple. The Priest here were accused of misbehaviour, harassment and unjust ﬁ nancial demands against the pilgrims. 144. ‘Hali System’ concerned : (a) Bonded labour (b) Exploitation of peasants (c) Untouchability (d) Illiteracy U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2015 Ans. (a) Hali System was concerned with bonded labour. 145. Who among the following leaders founded the revolutionary organization – 'Abhinav Bharat Society'? (a) Bhagat Singh (b) Vinayak Damodar Savarkar (c) Barindra Kumar Ghosh (d) Pulin Bihari U.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2018 Ans. (b) Vinayak Damodar Savarkar along with his brother Ganesh Damodar Savarkar started an organisation 'Mitra Mela'. It was renamed by V.D. Savarkar as 'Abhinav Bharat Society' at Nashik in 1904 Political Organisations Established Before Congress *Raja Ram Mohan Roy was the guide of social reforms and political movements in Modern India. His associates in 1836 for the ﬁ rst time started an association called Bangbhasa Prakashika Sabha. Raja Ram Mohan Roy was the earliest individual to struggle for political reforms in India. *Zamindari Association or Landholders society was established at Calcutta in 1838. This society marked the beginning of an organized political activity and use of methods of constitutional agitation for the redressal of grievances. The aim of the Society was to safeguard the rights of Zamindars. This Society was founded by Dwarkanath Tagore and his fellow Zamindars. * The Poona Sarvajanik sabha was one of the strongest political organiation of 19th century India. It was launched on 2 April 1870 in the Pune district of Maharashtra. It was the result of the labour of many great men like G.V. Joshi, S.H. Sathe and S.H. Chiplonkar. Fresh vigour and energy were infused into the sabha in November 1871 with the entry of M.G. Ranade. M.G. Ranade provided fantastic leadership to this Sabha. In 1875 this Sabha presented a petition in British House of Commons. The petition consisted of the demands of representatives of India. *Indian Association was founded on 26 th July, 1876 by Surendranath Banerjee with the help of Anand Mohan Bose in Calcutta. This was the most important political association before Congress with the tag of an All India Nationalist Organisation. Surendranath Banerjee passed the Civil Services exam in 1869, but as there was some trouble over his exact age he was declared disqualiﬁ ed. He published 'The Bengalee' newspaper for the promotion of mass consciousness. He was Congress President twice. *British Indian Association was started on October, 1851 in Calcutta whose founders were Rajendra Lal Mitra, Radhakant Dev (President) and Devendra Nath Tagore (General Secretary) etc. *Sayed Amir Ali in 1877 founded Central National Mohammadian Association at Calcutta. *Getting inspired from Raj Narayan Bose, Nabagopal Mitra in 1867 founded a Society named ‘Hindu Mela’. The main aim of this society was to promote the feeling of autonomy and use of indigenous goods amongst the masses.* In 1843, George Thompson founded Bengal British India Society.* Bombay Presidency Association was founded in 1885 by Firozshah Mehta, K.T. Telang and Badruddin Tyabjee. These three are known as Trimurti of Bombay. 1. The ﬁ rst Political Organization established in India in 1838 was known as (a) British India Society (b) Bengal British India Society (c) Settlers Association (d) Zamindari Association Uttarakhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2010 I.A.S. (Pre) 1993 Ans. (d) The ﬁ rst political organization established in India was known as the Zamindari Association or Landholders Society (1838) in Calcutta. It was the ﬁ rst political organisation which introduced organized eﬀ orts and constitutional remedies for complaints. Its main purpose was to secure the interests of landlords. The founder members were Dwaraka Nath Tagore and his associate landlords. 2. Given below are two statements, in which one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R): Assertion (A): The Bengal British Indian Society was founded in 1843 as a result of George Thompson's eﬀ orts. Reason (R): George Thompson was brought out from England by Dwarkanath Tagore to organise the political movement.
questions.explanation_hi: सही उत्तर: (C) उपरोक्त प्रश्न का स्पष्टीकरण देखें. 122 गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले ने सर्वेंट्स ऑफ इंडिया सोसाइटी की स्थापना वर्ष में की थी (ए) 1907 (बी) 1906 (सी) 1904 (डी) 1905 (ई) प्रश्न का प्रयास नहीं किया गया राज। पी.सी.एस. (पूर्व) 2023 उत्तर. (डी) 'सर्वेंट्स ऑफ इंडियन सोसाइटी' की स्थापना 12 जून, 1905 को महाराष्ट्र के पुणे जिले में फर्ग्यूसन पहाड़ी पर गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले द्वारा की गई थी। गोखले ने अपने तीन दोस्तों - नतेश अप्पाजी द्रविड़, गोपाल कृष्ण देवधर और अनंत विनायक पटवर्धन के साथ सोसायटी की स्थापना की, ये सभी सोसायटी के आजीवन सदस्य बने। समाज ने शिक्षा, सामाजिक कल्याण, वंचितों के उत्थान और समाज के वंचित वर्ग की बेहतरी जैसी राष्ट्र-निर्माण गतिविधियों पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया। 123.बहुजन समाज के संस्थापक कौन थे? (ए) श्री नारायण गुरु (बी) मुकुंद राव पाटिल (सी) डॉ. बी.आर. अम्बेडकर (डी) बी.आर. शिंदे यू.पी. निचला उप. (विशेष) (पूर्व) 2010 उत्तर। (बी) मुकुंद राव पाटिल और शंकर राव जाधव ने ब्राह्मणों, साहूकारों और जमींदारों सहित उच्च जातियों द्वारा निचली जातियों के शोषण का विरोध करने के लिए बहुजन समाज की स्थापना की। इसने भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस पार्टी का भी विरोध किया। बाद में यह ब्रिटिश सरकार का समर्थक बन गया। 124. मंदिरों में प्रवेश के अधिकार की मांग किसने की जिसके कारण 1899 में तिरुनेवली में भयानक दंगा हुआ? (ए) ओकलिंगा (बी) नादर (सी) महार (डी) पाली 40वीं बी.पी.एस.सी. (पूर्व) 1995 उत्तर.
